region.title: Choose your store
region.lead: We pick the store from your location. Indonesia shops in Rupiah with Bahasa Indonesia, every other country shops in US dollars in English.
region.note: You can switch at any time. Orders, stock and payment methods are handled separately in each store.

region.title: Pilih toko kamu
region.lead: Toko dipilih otomatis dari lokasi kamu. Indonesia berbelanja dengan Rupiah dan Bahasa Indonesia, negara lain memakai dolar AS dan English.
region.note: Kamu bisa pindah kapan saja. Pesanan, stok, dan metode pembayaran diatur terpisah di tiap toko.
